notes: As an overall cotton candy fan, one of Alani's worst flavors. It has no idea what it's doing, and no curated taste experience.
body:
I LOVE Alani. Overall one of my favorite brand. But this one was a miss. This drink feels like if a fever dream. While drinking it, it taste like a weird artificial cotton candy with subdued sweetness. After drinking, it's very drying, leaving a strange sweet aftertaste that's neither enjoyable or hydrating. I need a lot of water to get it out.

Overall taste: Honestly, while drinking it's okay. It's chuggable if that's something you care about. It's a decent cotton candy. Honestly on taste alone, it's not amazing, but probably a 6-6.4. What really brings it down is everything else.

Overall experience: Nearly nothing hits your taste buds when you first start drinking. Some sweetness builds up as you drink, but not a whole lot. But the dryness and aftertaste afterward are headache inducing. Have water closeby.

Nothing really stands out here. Meh drinking experience, no sour or tart to remember it by, with a bad aftertaste. Skip it unless you really need a drink.
name: Cotton Candy
